label: Case · Correspondence

changes.summary: Correspondence column Type: Correspondence or the e-mail's type, with its query chip; Subject opens the message.
Tag as query becomes Open query: one query per e-mail, opened through the one route.
Assigned to column; a new query is Unassigned until taken or assigned.
Per-query Mark done replaces Resolve query (which closed every open query).
Inline Assigned to selector and Take on each open query; Subject opens the message.
Reopen on a Done row: any staff role and Automation, no reason, while the Case is not archived or closed.
Query acts need no edit session, expected version or reason.
Query stays the purple stage word while any query is open.
